# Theme `bandean-v2` — ghi chú thiết kế chi tiết

Chuyển nguyên văn từ CLAUDE.md (2026-11-17) để CLAUDE.md gọn hơn. Đọc trước khi sửa theme này. Theme + các mục nói chung (Themes, `_campus`, `data_project`...) nằm trong đoạn dưới.

- Only the **public** site is themable. Themes: `default`, `nam-binh-duong` (SBUT), `ban-de-an`, `bandean-v2` (independent copy of `ban-de-an` for the redesign; since 2026-11-12 a **site of its own**, `bandean-v2` in `projects.php`, that works on the DATA of Ban Đề án (`'data_project' => 'ban-de-an'`; `ProjectContext::dataKey()` is what the social module, `ProjectPostAssigner`, the Facebook/Zalo connection services and the project badge use for posts/publication history/social accounts, while `key()` stays `bandean-v2` for theme, guides, login design and the permission manifest; a project without `data_project` owns its data); own views/CSS/JS, own login design; it is meant to run as its own deployment (own domain, `CMS_PROJECT_KEY=bandean-v2`) on the Ban Đề án database; every project key needs a folder `Modules/CmsBackend/resources/guides/<key>/`, guarded by `SocialGuidesTest`; a server for it would set `CMS_PROJECT_KEY=bandean-v2` and needs its own DB and permission manifest). Its home page follows design `bannerSBUT` (`design-input/bannerSBUT`, git-ignored): header bar, hero (`components/home/university-hero`, renderer of the `hero` block) with the featured statistics ON the banner (the `statistics` block left its default layout; `hero` declares data group `statistics` in `HomepageDataNeeds`), and the main menu BELOW the hero inside the `shortcuts` block (the layout skips its top menu bar when `$homeContentHtml` is set); CSS `css/screens/bandean-v2/banner.css` (header/hero/menu) and `sections.css` (rebuilt content blocks: introduction `#gioi-thieu`, programs `#dao-tao` as skewed cards (`.bd2-list`/`.bd2-card`), research `#nghien-cuu` as a card strip (`.bd2-grid`/`.bd2-tile`); the news, research and documents strips all show at most 3 cards per view, scroll horizontally when there are more (pager code in `theme.js`) and the script adds `.is-centered` to the track when everything fits, which centres fewer-than-3 cards; news `#tin-tuc` as a filterable horizontal scroll-snap strip with a page counter (`.bd2-carousel`; pager code at the end of `js/screens/bandean-v2/theme.js`, filter hooks stay those of `campus-base.js`); admissions `#tuyen-sinh` as copy + 4 notice cards (optional images `admissions-mascot.png`, `admissions-photo.jpg` in `public/assets/img/themes/bandean-v2/`, absent = skipped / campus photo); documents `#van-ban` as square-cornered paper-sheet cards with a folded corner (`.bd2-doc`, file `proposal-documents.blade.php`, grey lines are decoration; at most 3 per view, more scroll horizontally with the same `data-bd2-carousel` pager as the news strip; the source `HomeBlocks::documents` limits to 4 for every theme); media `#video-gioi-thieu` as a 3D coverflow on a green campus background (`.bd2-flow`; same spring/drag/autoplay mechanics as `effects/gallery-orbit` — float position, drag follows the pointer, flick moves one card, autoplay `data-bd2-flow-autoplay` ms (0 = off) paused on hover/focus/drag; the script is the `data-bd2-flow` block at the end of `js/screens/bandean-v2/theme.js`); audience links `#lien-ket-nhanh` as two white cards with a 2-column outlined link grid (`.bd2-aud-*`; destinations come from the theme's OWN `audience_links` in `screens.php`, link list from the `$audiences` array copied from `_campus`); own renderers `components/home/{introduction,programs,research,news,admissions,proposal-documents,media,audience-links}.blade.php`). Bump the theme `version` in `screens.php` when a renderer changes (homepage fragment cache key). Palette: brand tokens in `theme.css` (line 2) are the bandean-v2 green/gold/orange set; `css/screens/bandean-v2/palette.css` and `typography.css` are GENERATED by `node scripts/bandean-v2-derived-css.mjs` (`--check` reports drift): palette = the blue declarations of `shared/campus-base.css` hue-shifted to green, typography = every `font-size` wrapped in `max(value, var(--bd2-fs-min))` so no text is smaller than 16.8px (15.6px on phones), the size of the admissions ticker line (token in `banner.css`); selectors are prefixed `.proposal-public.sbut-public`, the shared file is untouched for the other themes — rerun the script after editing any `font-size`/blue colour in campus-base.css, theme.css, sections.css or banner.css instead of hand-editing the two files. The main menu bar is pinned with `position: fixed` (class `.is-pinned` on `.bd2-menu-slot`, toggled by `theme.js`; the slot keeps its height so nothing jumps) instead of `position: sticky`, which lags/stutters when the main thread is busy; no pin on phones. Scroll-linked effects of this theme must stay compositor-only (the progress bar uses `transform: scaleX`, never `width`/`scrollHeight` per frame: that forced ~173 layouts per scroll pass and made the sticky menu stutter); likewise no `backdrop-filter`/blur filters on big surfaces (glass panels use plain semi-opaque backgrounds, the video section background is an unfiltered photo under an overlay). Font: local variable Roboto (no Google Fonts); see docs/design-standards/BO-MAU-THEME.md section 6. The live layout plan is cached forever (`HomepageLayoutService::live`): after changing a theme layout class run `homepage:layout-install` / clear that cache, or the old renderer name fails with `Screen not found`. Admin is hard-wired to `screens/default`; do not add admin themes. The selection is stored as option `cms_public_theme` (the old `cms_home_theme` is ignored).
